units.source_text: 他抓住绳索，慢慢地把体重加上去。

en.t: He gripped the rope and slowly put his weight onto it.

units.source_text: 忽然，绳索像橡皮筋似的伸长了。

en.t: Suddenly, the rope stretched like a rubber band.

units.source_text: 他吓了一跳，毛孔里喷出冷汗。

en.t: He started in fright, cold sweat bursting from his pores.

units.source_text: 幸好才伸长了三十厘米左右就停了下来。

en.t: Fortunately, it stopped after stretching only about thirty centimeters.

units.source_text: 他把体重全加上去，这回看来没什么问题。

en.t: He put his full weight on it, and this time there seemed to be no problem.

units.source_text: 他照手心里吐了口唾沫，用脚掌夹住了绳索，开始往上攀登。

en.t: He spat into his palms, gripped the rope with the soles of his feet, and began climbing upward.

units.source_text: 那是玩具猴子爬树的方法。

en.t: It was the way a toy monkey climbs a tree.

units.source_text: 也许是太兴奋了吧，额头上沁出的汗奇怪地冰凉。

en.t: Perhaps he was too excited; the sweat beading on his forehead was strangely cold.

units.source_text: 他尽可能不让沙子塌方，身子完全靠绳索吊住，所以，咕噜咕噜转个不停，安定不下来。

en.t: Trying as hard as he could not to make the sand collapse, he let the rope support his whole body, so he kept spinning round and round, unable to steady himself.

units.source_text: 往上爬没有想象中那么容易，进展甚微，引力这玩意儿可真是个顽固的东西。

en.t: Climbing up was not as easy as he had imagined; he made very little progress, and gravity was truly a stubborn thing.

units.source_text: 可是，这颤抖究竟是怎么回事呢？

en.t: But what on earth was this trembling?

units.source_text: 最终，手臂像是和意志脱了钩，勇往直前，像是自己要把自己弹飞出去似的。

en.t: In the end, his arms seemed to come unhooked from his will, pushing recklessly ahead as if they meant to fling him away from himself.

units.source_text: 是呵，一想起那沾满毒素的四十六天，也是理所当然。

en.t: Yes, when he thought of those forty-six days steeped in poison, it was only natural.

units.source_text: 上了一米，就成了百米的深度，上了两米，就成了两百米的深度。

en.t: Climb one meter, and it became a depth of a hundred meters; climb two meters, and it became a depth of two hundred meters.

units.source_text: 随着深度的增加，底下成了令人头晕目眩的深渊……

en.t: As the depth increased, the space below became a dizzying abyss...

units.source_text: 实在太累了……

en.t: He was unbearably tired...

units.source_text: 往下看可不行！……

en.t: He must not look down!...

units.source_text: 瞧呵，那儿就是地面呀……

en.t: Look, there was the ground...

units.source_text: 地面上，不管往哪个方向，都有可以自由行走的道路，通往世界尽头……

en.t: On the ground, in every direction, there were roads one could walk freely, leading to the end of the world...

units.source_text: 一爬到地面上，所有一切都在追忆的笔记本里，变成了小小的花瓣书签……

en.t: Once he climbed up to the ground, everything would become, inside the notebook of memory, a tiny bookmark made of flower petals...

units.source_text: 毒草也罢，食肉植物也罢，都成了一片薄薄的半透明彩纸。

en.t: Poisonous weeds and carnivorous plants alike would all become a thin sheet of translucent colored paper.

units.source_text: 客厅里，喝着粗茶，和暖的电灯下，成为闲话的佐料。

en.t: In the sitting room, while drinking plain tea under a warm electric light, they would become material for idle talk.
